Package logic

Class PersonDetails

java.lang.Object
logic.PersonDetails
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PersonDetails extends Object implements Serializable
editable personal-details projection for a registered person (visitor, subscriber, or guide), used by the "My Details" view (subscriber sees and edits their own) and the Service Rep's view/edit-any-user panel.

the idNumber is the immutable key. creditCard and familySize are only meaningful for subscribers (they are blank/0 for plain visitors and guides). role is one of "VISITOR", "SUBSCRIBER", "GUIDE".

  • Constructor Details

    • PersonDetails

      public PersonDetails(String idNumber, String firstName, String lastName, String email, String phone, String creditCard, int familySize, String role, boolean isSubscriber, int subscriberNumber)
      Parameters:
      idNumber - the person's government ID (immutable key)
      firstName - first name
      lastName - last name
      email - contact email
      phone - contact phone
      creditCard - subscriber credit card, or null/empty if none
      familySize - subscriber family size, or 0 if not a subscriber
      role - "VISITOR", "SUBSCRIBER", or "GUIDE"
      isSubscriber - convenience flag mirroring role.equals("SUBSCRIBER")
      subscriberNumber - the unique member number, or 0 if not a subscriber
